feat(hybrid): CSR probe (--probe) + manifest-driven transport caps

`--probe <list>` halts the freshly reset hart over DMI and checked-reads each
CSR address, emitting a CSV of the implemented set plus architectural reset
values; a cmderr on an unimplemented CSR surfaces as absent. This lets andesim's
manifest generator MEASURE an engine's real CSR inventory and reset values
instead of hand-tracing RTL parameters. `--transport-csrs <manifest>` closes the
loop: it rebuilds the exact AndesCaps from the manifest's transported set via
`andes_caps_from_transport_set` and installs it with `set_transport_caps`, so
every caps consumer now routes through one `active_caps()` indirection that
prefers the manifest override over the config-derived caps. The probe itself
lives in `probe_csrs()` on the simulator, while its list-read and CSV-emit
helpers stay in free functions in main.cpp so their code is instantiated once
rather than per CPU class. Together these let the runtime transport be driven by
the registered manifest rather than by re-modelling config macros, making the
config->caps mirror redundant. This is the final step of the series; the tree now
matches the old tip except for the documented cleanup delta.
